turns.prompt: A trade counter hand at Hollinrake Timber asked how a pack of sawn boards is measured for pricing; a board foot is the volume of a square foot of board one inch thick, and packs are quoted in the same unit. Pack P-24 holds 8 boards, each 1.5 inches thick, 4 inches wide and 12 feet long. Give the volume of the pack, as a single number in board feet with no unit in the reply. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
